question.problem:
The number of heads facing upward after tossing $3$ unfair coins follows the probability mass function $f(x)$ shown in the table below. What is the expected value of the number of heads facing upward after tossing the $3$ coins? Do not round the answer.

| $x$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $\frac{2}{9}$ | $\frac{1}{3}$ | $\frac{1}{9}$ | $\frac{1}{3}$ |

$\text{E}[X]=$
{{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =0\cdot f(0)+1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3) \\  & =0(\frac{2}{9})+1(\frac{1}{3})+2(\frac{1}{9})+3(\frac{1}{3}) \\  & =0+\frac{1}{3}+\frac{2}{9}+1 \\  & =0+\frac{3}{9}+\frac{2}{9}+\frac{9}{9} \\  & =\frac{0+3+2+9}{9} \\  & =\frac{14}{9}.\end{aligned}
$$
